zh.principle: **算法**：双线性配对（Bilinear Pairing）。留存件的 §2.1 给出对象的定义性三性：「a mathematical construction known as the Tate pairing provides an efficiently computable map e: G1' x G1'' -> G2 that is linear in both arguments and believed hard to invert [BF].」三要件是可高效计算、双变量线性、以及被认为难以求逆——双线性对的全部用途都建立在这三条的组合上。
zh.why: 为什么要专门规范它，§1 一句话点出下游：文件服务于「identity-based encryption (IBE) systems based on bilinear pairings」。而能不能用，取决于曲线是否给出额外结构：「If an efficiently computable non-rational endomorphism phi: G1' ->…is available for the selected elliptic curve on which the Tate pairing is computed」（该句在留存件里跨页，省略号只标示被跳过的页眉页脚）——有了这个自同态才有修正版配对，才有可用于标识加密的群配对。
zh.used: 命名与选型规则印在留存件的 §2.1（本文件的目录用另一套编号，正文节号以留存件为准）：「called the modified Tate pairing.We generically call a pairing either the Tate pairing e or the modified Tate pairing e', depending on the chosen elliptic curve used in a particular implementation.」也即工程上没有自由选项——用哪一版本由所选曲线的性质决定，实现在两条路里被曲线二选一。
zh.broken: 限度写在用词与记号里。求逆难度在本文件里的措辞是「believed hard to invert」——是被相信的困难性，不是被证明的困难性。记号表把底域阶 p 规定为 512 位到 7680 位的素数（该量级按原样复述、不逐字引用），说明这一族构造的规模远大于普通 ECC 群。合起来的结论是：安全假设立在猜测之上，且曲线与域参数必须按文件挑，不能随手替换成别的群。

en.principle: **Algorithm**: Bilinear Pairing (双线性配对). Section 2.1 of the retained text gives the defining trio: "a mathematical construction known as the Tate pairing provides an efficiently computable map e: G1' x G1'' -> G2 that is linear in both arguments and believed hard to invert [BF]." The three requirements are efficient computability, linearity in both arguments and conjectured inversion hardness - every use of pairings rests on that combination.
en.why: Why it needs specifying at all: §1 of the retained text names the downstream purpose in one phrase - the document serves "identity-based encryption (IBE) systems based on bilinear pairings". Whether a curve can serve depends on extra structure printed in §2.1: "If an efficiently computable non-rational endomorphism phi: G1' ->…is available for the selected elliptic curve on which the Tate pairing is computed" (the sentence straddles a page break in the retained file; the ellipsis marks only the skipped header and footer). That endomorphism is what yields the modified pairing identity-based schemes use.
en.used:
Naming and selection are printed in §2.1 of the retained text: "called the modified Tate pairing. We generically call a pairing either the Tate pairing e or the modified Tate pairing e', depending on the chosen elliptic curve used in a particular implementation." Engineering-wise the choice is not free: the curve decides which of the two constructions an implementation can use.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: The limits are in the wording and the notation. Inversion hardness is phrased as "believed hard to invert" - a conjecture, not a theorem. The notation list fixes the base field order p as a prime of 512 to 7680 bits (restated, not quoted, to keep one citation span per sentence), an order of magnitude beyond ordinary ECC groups. Together: the assumption rests on belief, and the curve and field parameters must be chosen as the document specifies rather than swapped for another group at will.
en.history: Lineage and identity: this document specifies the Tate and modified Tate pairings together with curve implementations so identity-based systems can cite them, and its motive sentence names "identity-based encryption (IBE) systems based on bilinear pairings". The header prints Request for Comments: 5091, Category: Informational, December 2007, by Boyen, Martin and Wang (restated outside quotes per house rule). The mathematical objects come from an earlier line of pairing research; the document offers no history, only the boundary of what is usable.

zh: 双线性对：对两个变量都线性、且被认为难以求逆的可高效计算映射。
Tate pairing：在曲线子群与扩域目标群之间构造的那一版本。
修正 Tate 配对：对第二个变量施加非有理自同态后得到的 e'。
G1' 与 G1''：配对的两个输入子群。
G2：配对输出所在的扩域目标子群。
非有理自同态：使 e' 可构造的曲线附加结构。
en: Bilinear pairing: an efficiently computable map linear in both arguments and believed hard to invert.
Tate pairing: the construction between elliptic-curve subgroups and a target group in an extension field.
Modified Tate pairing: the map e' obtained by applying a non-rational endomorphism to the second argument.
G1' and G1'': the two input subgroups of the pairing.
G2: the target subgroup where pairing outputs live.
Non-rational endomorphism: the extra curve structure that makes e' constructible.
